question: Should LiteLLM have a first-class interactive base URL and model discovery step in onboard, or should remote LiteLLM setups be intentionally routed through Custom Provider, non-interactive setup, or manual config?
rationale: Both directions fit different OpenClaw boundaries: provider-owned prompts repair the reported LiteLLM flow, while Custom Provider keeps the bundled provider path lean but leaves the reported interactive LiteLLM choice unsupported for remote proxies.

options.title: Add LiteLLM Interactive Setup
options.body: Give the LiteLLM plugin an owned interactive base URL prompt plus model discovery or selection behavior, with tests and docs for fresh and existing config paths.

options.title: Route Remote Proxies Elsewhere
options.body: Keep built-in LiteLLM onboarding minimal and update setup copy/docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider, non-interactive --custom-base-url, or manual config.

options.title: Defer To Provider Catalog Redesign
options.body: Leave this open until maintainers choose the broader credentialed live-catalog and provider setup API policy.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM Interactive Setup
recommendation.body: Give the LiteLLM plugin an owned interactive base URL prompt plus model discovery or selection behavior, with tests and docs for fresh and existing config paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant LiteLLM pluginization and provider onboarding boundary history is concentrated in this owner path.
